item.title: Lisa Ray marks 25 years of Kasoor, calls it a defining film that challenged Bollywood norms
item.description: Mumbai: Actress Lisa Ray is celebrating 25 years of her 2001 film Kasoor, a project she says marked a defining moment in her career and quietly challenged the conventions of Hindi cinema at the time. Lisa took to Instagram, where she shared the music video of “Mohabbat Ho Na Jaye” from the film “Kasoor”. item.title: President Murmu visits Biraja temple in Jajpur, performs Pinda Daan at Nabhi Gaya [Watch Video]
item.description: Jajpur: President Droupadi Murmu, who is currently on a visit to Odisha, visited the Maa Biraja Temple in Jajpur and offered prayers today. She left Bhubaneswar in the morning and reached Jajpur in a special helicopter.
